description: This file contains the class `Language` in the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup` namespace, responsible for managing language initialization and loading in the admin startup process of the OpenCart application.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for handling language setup during the admin startup process in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes available languages, sets the default or cookie-stored language, and configures language paths.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Loads language data after initial setup, supporting fallback to default language if necessary.
